candidates.title: Will Carlos Alcaraz win at least 2.5 more games than Alexander Zverev?

candidates.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to the Alexander Zverev vs Carlos Alcaraz professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP World Tour Finals Men Singles Final. If a retirement occurs, all markets that can be unconditionally settled based on play already completed will resolve accordingly. candidates.rules_secondary:
